ReviewPolicy: Revalidate product packaging, availability, workload support, licensing, and price with the vendor during solution design and immediately before ordering.

ShareGate.SubscriptionModel: Annual flat-rate subscription for the included workloads, based on machine activations.

Plans.Name: ShareGate Migrate Essentials
Plans.Notes: Best fit for a simple collaboration migration. Exchange Online, Entra ID migration, sensitivity-label migration, and multi-workstation concurrency require Pro or Enterprise.

Plans.Name: ShareGate Migrate Pro
Plans.Notes: Best fit for a medium or parallelized project, or when ShareGate will also migrate Exchange Online or other Pro-only workloads.

Plans.Name: ShareGate Migrate Enterprise
Plans.Notes: Best fit for larger tenants or projects that need up to 25 migration workstations and 24/7 prioritized support.

MigrationOrchestrator.Name: Microsoft 365 Migration Orchestrator
MigrationOrchestrator.StatusNote: Verify preview or general-availability status and current workload limitations at project start.

CrossTenantUserDataMigration.Name: Cross-Tenant User Data Migration
CrossTenantUserDataMigration.PurchaseModel: One-time add-on license per migrating user

CrossTenantSharedDataMigration.Name: Cross-Tenant Shared Data Migration
CrossTenantSharedDataMigration.PurchaseModel: Separate SharePoint migration SKU sold in 100 GB units; validate current purchasing-channel eligibility
CrossTenantSharedDataMigration.Availability: Currently documented for Enterprise Agreement customers

BitTitan.Name: BitTitan MigrationWiz
BitTitan.PurchaseModel: Commercial per-user or per-workload licensing; recalculate after final mailbox, archive, and exception scope is confirmed.
